snippet.title: Coup de Grass - Go And Touch Some Grass | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free demo and wishlist Coup de Grass on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4917900/Coup_de_Grass/

Start with a single sickle and a small field. Build a sprawling incremental empire. 

Coup de Grass is an incremental management game about cutting grass. First you do it manually, then you sell it and invest in upgrades, hire workers, and build a whole operation. Then you move out to new fields with unique themes and tackle their objectives.

Trailer Music: pegonthetrack & ELV Games.

#coupdegrass #godot #indiedev #indiegame #gamedev #steamgames #incremental
